context.transcript:
Hi, I'm calling because I think I left my jacket in the overhead compartment on the plane.
It's blue with white stripes.
I arrived earlier today on flight 98 from London.
Okay, I'll just need your seat number so we can check the row you were sitting in.
That should be enough information to locate the jacket.
Um, I was sitting in 36F in the last row of the plane.
All right, we'll call you when we find it.
And just so you know, you'll have to come to the airline counter in the baggage claim area to retrieve it.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，我打电话来是因为我想我的夹克掉在飞机上的头顶行李舱里了。
它是蓝色的，带白色条纹的。
我今天早些时候乘坐98航班从伦敦到达的。
好的，我只需要你的座位号，这样我们就能查到你坐的排了。
这应该有足够的信息来找到夹克。
嗯，我坐在飞机最后排的36F座。
没关系，找到它我们会打电话通知你的。
另外提醒你，你需要到行李提取区的航空公司柜台去取。
